analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (171,300 KRW) vs SMA5 (178,400 KRW)/SMA20 (198,060 KRW)/SMA50 (226,376 KRW): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, entering weak territory.
· Significant decline relative to SMA100 (240,707 KRW)/SMA200 (238,403 KRW), indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (26.0%): Current price level is near the 52-week low, in a historically low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (40.3 → 34.3): Entering oversold territory, potential for rebound but weak signal for trend reversal.
· MACD histogram trajectory (23.6881 → -1492.9299): Continued worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 165,834 KRW): Approaching the lower band, potential for bounce.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (167,300 KRW): Close to 5-day/20-day low (170,000 KRW), expecting short-term support.
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW): High level relative to current price, potential for trend reversal if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High continuation): Strengthening downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.78x): Contracted compared to the 5-day average, reducing reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Insufficient buy signals due to RSI entering oversold and weak ADX trend, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
